summary.text: Pricey Harrison (Mary Harrison on Ballotpedia) is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives for District 61 in Guilford County and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as retired communications attorney and her service as 11 terms in the House.

paragraphs.text: Pricey Harrison holds a bachelor's degree from Duke University and a law degree from the University of North Carolina School of Law, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly lists her occupation as retired communications attorney and a mailing address in Greensboro.
The Democratic primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
